title: Pauline Weaver's San Gorgonio Pass home — reconstruction drawing by Sharon Estrada (published 2002)
original_title: Pauline Weaver's home in San Gorgonio Pass

date.basis: The user identifies the reproduction as page 166 of Peggy Christian's 2002 book. The caption credits Sharon Estrada and cites a book by O.C. Ord from 1856 as a source; it does not date the drawing to 1856.

caption: Reconstruction drawing of Pauline Weaver's home in the San Gorgonio Pass, showing a low rancho complex beneath the mountains; drawn by Sharon Estrada and published in Historic San Timoteo Canyon, page 166.
description: A modern reconstruction rather than a contemporaneous view. The printed caption says the site was the third rancho on the mission circuit, that Weaver took over after the mission's 1834 abandonment, and that he never received title; it credits Sharon Estrada's drawing as based on a book by O.C. Ord dated 1856. Those historical statements are preserved as the book's claims and have not been independently verified here. The 1856 citation is source context, not the artwork's creation date.
attribution: Drawing by Sharon Estrada, based on a book by O.C. Ord (1856); reproduced in Peggy Christian, Historic San Timoteo Canyon (2002), p. 166
